MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | CI/CD & Platform Engineering
marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including hands-on ownership of CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and test environments. Built GitLab CI workflows and Helm-based ephemeral environments for three product teams, and developed a personal k3s/GitOps homelab with Terraform-provisioned Hetzner infrastructure. Seeking a DevOps or platform engineering role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose
Infrastructure and orchestration: Helm, Kubernetes (shared-cluster namespace-level access; personal k3s), Terraform (personal project), Argo CD
Observability and systems: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Linux, Git
Programming and data: Python, Bash, Java (test code), SQL, PostgreSQL
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Cloud learning: AWS (EC2 and S3 basics)
Additional: Ansible (basic), TLS certificates with cert-manager

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | 2021–Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and moving end-to-end tests to on-demand ephemeral environments; monthly CI runner costs fell by about 30%.
- Built short-lived merge-request test environments using Docker Compose and Helm on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky-test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling to seed test data into PostgreSQL.
- Authored internal documentation on how CI works, used for onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | 2019–2021
- Performed manual and automated testing of web and mobile applications for client projects.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018–2019
- Investigated customer issues in logs and databases and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024–2025
- Built a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring, plus Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023–2024
- Implemented short-lived environments for each merge request, with the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data, deployed via Helm to the shared Kubernetes cluster from GitLab CI.
- Configured automatic cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments for feature reviews, with end-to-end tests running against them.

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health | 2023
- Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and created Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
- Teams used the dashboard to identify and fix top offenders; the flaky-test rate fell from 7% to below 1%.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA): studying; exam scheduled for January 2027 (not yet passed)

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. My experience owning CI/CD and test infrastructure for three product teams, alongside hands-on work with Kubernetes, Helm and observability, aligns with the operational foundations needed as Corvale prepares its new train fleet.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines serving approximately 25 developers. I built merge-request environments deployed through Helm to a shared Kubernetes cluster, with seeded PostgreSQL data, end-to-end testing and automatic cleanup. I also reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%. These projects have given me practical experience making development environments repeatable and easier for teams to use. I documented how our CI works for onboarding, and QA and product teams use the ephemeral environments to review features before merge.

I have also built a personal three-node k3s homelab using GitOps with Argo CD, and set up Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Traefik and cert-manager. My Terraform work so far is personal: I used it to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. My AWS exposure is also personal learning, covering EC2 and S3 basics, rather than work experience. I am currently studying for the CKA; the exam is scheduled for January 2027.

Corvale’s work connecting a new train fleet with cloud services is a compelling application of reliable, observable infrastructure. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my CI/CD, Kubernetes-environment and automation experience could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
